notes.title: Small Bug fixes + Sweet details added
notes.content:
[h1]This update contains:[/h1]

[h3]Small Bug Fixes:[/h3]
 
- Volume controls now working fine
- Issues on taking pieces in the Bonus levels now vanished. 

[h3]Simple Art details added:[/h3]

- Sweet [i]LIS like[/i] wind lines animations as you can see [url=https://twitter.com/RsoftGames/status/1408229708274274304]here[/url]
- Nice elements on menu backgrounds. 

[i]Everything for you to play better, and feel better. I really hope you enjoy!

Rafael Almeida. [/i]
